integrity.euler_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions; projectivity converts it to ordinary Euler characteristic.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for 1312.2577 lists its first submission on 2013-12-09.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A one-parameter subgroup with binary-separated row and column weights has precisely the matrix coordinate points as ambient projective fixed points, and every such point satisfies all permanents when r is at least two.
integrity.invariance_basis: Every r by r permanent is semi-invariant under diagonal row and column rescaling because each monomial uses every selected row and every selected column exactly once.
integrity.object_basis: The source defines the projective subscheme cut out by the r by r permanents of a generic m by n matrix.
integrity.primary_slot_basis: The published archival source lists MSC2010 primary 14M12.

scientific_limitations: The invariant is the ordinary Euler characteristic of the underlying reduced complex projective variety; nilpotent scheme structure is invisible to it.
The theorem does not determine Betti numbers, mixed Hodge structure, components, singularities, codimension, or degree.
The proof is short after choosing a suitable one-parameter subgroup, so an older unindexed observation may exist.
title: Every nontrivial permanental variety has ambient Euler characteristic
